turns.content: A resonance has width Gamma_X=320 MeV. Using hbar*c=1.97327e-16 GeV m, convert the width to GeV and calculate the proper decay length c*tau_0.
Its total energy is 8 GeV and its mass is 1.2 GeV. Calculate the momentum and beta*gamma.
Use L=(hbar*c/Gamma_X)(beta*gamma) to calculate the laboratory mean decay distance.
Check the internal consistency of the width, boost, and distance with that formula.
Verify the powers of ten and distinguish the proper decay length from the boosted laboratory distance.
Report the laboratory mean decay distance together with the width conversion and boost factor.
